title: Real-SWAP safeguarded physical-Newton qualification across configured SWAP windows and groundwater response regimes
question: Can a transaction-safe physical-tangent Newton corrector, with fixed backtracking on SWAP admissibility and residual non-increase, remain robust across materially different real-SWAP configured windows/forcings and MODFLOW storage/conductance regimes?

prior_evidence.g04: Analytical NH03 shows raw physical Newton can make a large excursion while safeguarded Newton remains bounded.
prior_evidence.g06: Real F-GC44 shows true corrector inadmissibility is participant status 6 and factor-1/2 contraction can recover it without accepted-state mutation.
prior_evidence.g07a: Live real-SWAP/MODFLOW phase-transition sweep validates local response theory but remains nearly affine in the SWAP fixture.
prior_evidence.dsw22d: Configured predictor matrix shows duration 5e-5 day fails at predictor status 104; durations 1e-4 and 2e-4 day are READY for qbot 5e-7,1e-6,2e-6 cm/day.

excluded_preserved_control.reason: Known DSW22 predictor status 104 before corrector construction; preserved as prior falsification, not retuned into G08.

tangent_estimator.acceptance: both side trials status 0, finite slope, slope < 0

material_nonlinearity.metric: maximum relative change of admissible local secant/tangent slope from the href tangent over the fixed scan
material_nonlinearity.note: Threshold is frozen before G08 execution. Failure to reach it means this fixture does not establish genuinely nonlinear real-SWAP qualification.

groundwater_response_contract.method: fresh converged constant-flux MODFLOW6 probes; affine q_gw(H)=aH+b fit used only as an independent diagnostic/merit oracle

starts.method: for each sign, choose the largest-magnitude status-0 point from the fixed head-offset scan; no post-hoc hand selection

policies.P1: At each accepted trial head, re-estimate the physical SWAP tangent, solve live MODFLOW with the reanchored tangent term, and take the raw Newton proposal if the SWAP trial is admissible.
policies.P4: Same physical-tangent proposal, then factor-1/2 backtracking toward the current head until the SWAP trial is admissible and |q_swap-q_gw_oracle| does not increase. Maximum 12 contractions.

convergence.reference_root: bisection on the independently fitted groundwater response and real-SWAP trial residual inside an admissible sign-changing fixed-scan bracket

authority_invariants: Committed SWAP revision/time and interface ledger remain at the immutable origin throughout G08.
Participant status 4 is lifecycle misuse, never head inadmissibility; only status 6 is corrector trial failure.
No production HCOF/RHS source or production coupling policy is changed.
decision_rules: Execution PASS means the frozen matrix ran with transaction invariants and independent groundwater-response checks intact; it is not production admission.
If no tested real-SWAP case exceeds the frozen 5% nonlinearity threshold, nonlinear real-SWAP qualification remains open.
If P4 never backtracks on any real-SWAP case, the real-SWAP safeguard mechanism remains unexercised even if all solves converge.
A stronger P4 result requires at least one case where a raw P1 proposal is inadmissible or increases the frozen merit function and P4 contracts to an admissible non-increasing proposal.
Production HCOF/RHS remains unchanged regardless of G08 outcome; any production mutation requires a separate admission work unit.

pre_execution_amendment.reason: Add a fixed accepted-groundwater head mismatch so Newton proposals traverse a nontrivial fraction of the real-SWAP corrector envelope. No G08 execution had occurred before this amendment.
pre_execution_amendment.effect: Groundwater model STRT and symmetric CHD center are shifted by the declared bias; SWAP reference/origin remains unchanged.
